problem_statement: Checkout: Thank you: WordPress.com Premium: Improve clarity on available storage space #### Steps to reproduce - Start with a free or WordPress.com Personal plan site - Upgrade to WordPress.com Premium plan from https://wordpress.com/plans - After payment, notice the feature set that mentions `Video and audio posts` on the "checkout thank you" page #### What happens It reads `Enrich your posts with video and audio, uploaded directly on your site. No ads or limits. The Premium plan also adds 10GB of file storage.` #### What is expected instead - The reference to "no limits" is removed, as we do have a limit on the storage space for WordPress.com Premium plan - The last line of the copy can be updated to `The WordPress.com Premium plan offers 13GB of file storage.` as the current line adds to confusion. The plan **does** add 10GB of file storage to free WordPress.com sites, but it **does not** add 10GB of file storage to WordPress.com Personal plan sites which already have 6GB in total. For simplicity's sake, updating the copy to what's available in total makes sense to me.
